intent_en: To explain how an increase in supply and a decrease in demand leads to falling prices and subsequent driver protests.
previous_intent: To illustrate how an increase in supply and a decrease in demand drive down prices, leading to anger and protests from drivers.
narration_support: when this line goes up and this one goes down, prices fall and drivers get angry. Like violent protests and the street angry.
chart_support: Supply and Demand graph showing an upward supply curve and downward demand curve, with a large green downward arrow indicating falling prices, accompanied by thumbs-down gestures and a pitchfork symbolizing anger/protest.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links the movement of supply (up) and demand (down) lines to falling prices and driver anger. The chart visualizes this with a standard supply/demand intersection, a downward price arrow, and protest imagery (pitchfork, thumbs down) matching the narration's description of 'violent protests' and 'street angry'.
